note: Bollinger Breakout + Daily Trend Confirmation (multi-timeframe, Strategy 3). Lower TF (default 4H): close > upper BB(20). Higher TF (Daily): close > SMA(200). use_daily_trend=True = ARM B (breakout + trend filter), False = ARM A (breakout alone). Baseline params only. Exit reuses existing lab ATR risk management.

signal.expression: (close[t] > upper[t]) AND (close[t-1] <= upper[t-1]) [AND Daily close[t] > Daily SMA(200)[t]]
signal.evaluatedAfter: low-TF bar close confirmed, high-TF candle fully closed (runner-injected, no leakage)
